'''Walinor''' was the [[President/Legends|president]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the border of the Republic during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Walinor was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] to a diplomatic summit on [[Outpost 256]], but Rakton seized the heads of state by force. Walinor and the others were rescued from Rakton's forces by [[Havoc Squad]].
